name: coupon-withdrawal-impact-cli
description: 优惠券发放包主播撤券影响分析工具

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:normal && npm run test:abnormal
scripts.test:normal: node dist/cli.js --batches test-data/batches.csv --records test-data/records.csv --orders test-data/orders.csv --output test-results/normal-result.csv
scripts.test:abnormal: node dist/cli.js --batches test-data/batches.csv --records test-data/records-abnormal.csv --orders test-data/orders-abnormal.csv --output test-results/abnormal-result.csv
